Run queries and mutations against business data.

Queries and mutations are `POST` operations with a GraphQL payload that defines the shape of the query or mutation to be made against the data schema, including custom objects and fields. A mutation with multiple operations is executed as an atomic transaction: either all operations succeed or none succeed.

info.name: Make batch queries and mutations using GraphQL.

items.docs:
GraphQL batching involves sending multiple queries or mutations to the server in a single request. This reduces the number of server round trips to fetch data, which makes interaction more efficient. 

See https://blog.apollographql.com/query-batching-in-apollo-63acfd859862 for more information
